capabilities: Animate note titles with a scramble-and-reveal effect
Adjust animation settings in the plugin settings
extras: The README covers usage only briefly and defers configuration details to the plugin settings; it contains no screenshots or examples of the animation styles.
motivation: The author saw the scrambling effect on the Aldnoah.Zero website login screen and wanted to recreate it.
problem: Obsidian opens notes with a static title; there is no built-in way to add a decorative scramble-and-reveal animation to it.
summary: Title animation plugin that scrambles and reveals the title of any note you open in several visual styles.
